## Environment <!-- Mandatory -->

Determine all applicable environment fields.

## Description <!-- Mandatory -->

State the question using complete thoughts. Use relevant user wording and technical terms for searchability. Restate the problem technically when possible. Add factual statements that clarify the issue and do not change when it is resolved.

## Steps to Reproduce <!-- Optional -->

Include reproduction steps only when there is a clean path that does not require customer-proprietary code.

## Error Message <!-- Optional -->

List exact relevant error messages. Remove customer-specific information, such as product names or file names.

## Cause/Possible Cause(s) <!-- Mandatory -->

Describe the root cause in customer-consumable language. Use discretion with proprietary information. If the cause is unknown, state:

> The exact cause is not known at this time.

## Solution <!-- Mandatory -->

Provide the verified resolution. Use bullets or numbered steps when applicable. If there is no verified resolution, state:

> No verified solution available. Check the [suggested workarounds](#suggested-workarounds) instead.

## Suggested Workarounds <!-- Optional -->

Describe workarounds when no verified solution is available. Use an `h3` heading for each workaround when there are multiple workarounds.

### Workaround #1

Content here...

## Notes <!-- Optional -->

Add applicable information that does not fit above, including references to other written documents.

## See Also <!-- Optional -->

Link to relevant documentation that can further help readers resolve the issue or achieve the desired behavior.
